episode.title: Close active terminal hyperlinks at truncation boundaries
episode.before: At parent commit 6bfd50261dfa103a761c2638965248381251827c, terminal text truncation finalized a retained prefix by appending only an SGR reset and optional ellipsis. If the prefix contained an OSC 8 hyperlink opener but truncation omitted its later closer, the emitted string left the hyperlink active beyond the retained label.
episode.after: At commit b780d20aa17c4144ace7bff728150993236b88ee, truncation scans the retained prefix for OSC 8 state. When a hyperlink remains active, it emits an OSC 8 close using the opener's BEL or ST terminator before the existing SGR reset and ellipsis. A focused test asserts the exact BEL-terminated output.
episode.diff: The change adds getActiveOsc8Close(), which reuses terminal-sequence extraction, OSC 8 parsing, and close formatting to derive a matching close sequence from the retained prefix. finalizeTruncatedResult() now inserts that close before its reset in both ellipsis and no-ellipsis branches. The regression test constructs a BEL-terminated link whose label is truncated and verifies that the synthesized close precedes the reset and ellipsis.

evidence_units.claim: The pinned commit identifies the defect as an OSC 8 hyperlink left open when truncation cuts through its label and states that the fix closes the active hyperlink while preserving BEL or ST termination.
In the parent implementation, finalizeTruncatedResult() appended an SGR reset directly after the retained prefix, with no OSC 8 state inspection or hyperlink close.
The changed implementation computes getActiveOsc8Close(prefix) and inserts its result between the retained prefix and the existing SGR reset in both finalization branches.

getActiveOsc8Close() scans complete terminal sequences in the retained prefix, updates active hyperlink state for OSC 8 open and close sequences, and formats a close only when a hyperlink remains active.
OSC 8 parsing records whether the sequence uses BEL or ST, and close formatting emits the same terminator, allowing truncation finalization to preserve the active link's framing convention.
evidence_units.source: git show b780d20aa17c4144ace7bff728150993236b88ee:packages/tui/src/utils.ts, Osc8Terminator, parseOsc8Hyperlink(), and formatOsc8Close()

evidence_units.claim: The implementation diff adds hyperlink-state reconciliation without changing width accounting, prefix selection, padding, or ellipsis selection.
The added regression test truncates a BEL-terminated OSC 8 label and requires the output to contain a synthesized BEL close immediately before the SGR reset and ellipsis.

candidate_atomics.name: close-active-link-at-truncation-boundary
candidate_atomics.title: Close an active hyperlink before truncated output ends
candidate_atomics.description: Reconcile structured hyperlink state at a text truncation boundary by detecting whether the retained prefix still has an active link and emitting a matching close sequence before resets, ellipses, or following terminal content.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a hyperlink whose label was truncated from extending into the ellipsis or subsequent terminal content.
semantic_action.module_role: Terminal text truncation finalizer responsible for producing self-contained control-sequence output.
semantic_action.pre_state: A truncation operation retained a prefix that may contain an OSC 8 opener while omitting the corresponding closer from the original input.
semantic_action.post_state: If the retained prefix ends with an active OSC 8 hyperlink, the finalized output closes it with the same BEL or ST terminator before applying the existing reset and optional ellipsis; otherwise no hyperlink close is added.
semantic_action.validation: Construct an input whose hyperlink closer lies after the truncation boundary and assert the exact finalized sequence, including the matching OSC 8 close before the reset and ellipsis. The committed oracle covers the BEL form.

candidate_workflows.name: repair-unbalanced-link-state-after-text-truncation
candidate_workflows.title: Repair hyperlink state when truncating terminal text
candidate_workflows.description: Use the retained prefix, rather than the discarded suffix, to determine whether truncation has split a structured hyperlink span; close any surviving active link at the output boundary while preserving established width and ellipsis behavior.

workflow_graph.goal: Produce width-bounded terminal text whose hyperlink control state cannot leak from a truncated label into the ellipsis or later rendered content.
when_to_use: A text truncation or clipping function preserves embedded hyperlink control sequences in its retained prefix.
The original hyperlink closer can fall in the discarded suffix, leaving the retained output structurally unbalanced.
anti_goals: Do not remove hyperlink targets or visible label content that fits within the existing width budget.
Do not alter visible-width calculation, truncation position, padding, or ellipsis policy.
Do not treat a generic style reset as sufficient to close a separate hyperlink protocol.
not_applicable_when: The output format has no stateful link-open/link-close protocol.
The transformation always preserves complete structured spans or strips all control sequences before output.
The reported problem concerns choosing or launching a browser target rather than balancing an encoded link boundary.
inputs: Encoded terminal text that may contain OSC 8 hyperlinks
Parser capable of distinguishing hyperlink open and close sequences
workflow_graph.entry_state: Truncation can retain an OSC 8 opener while discarding its closer, and finalization appends only style resets or ellipsis content.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Every actually truncated output closes any hyperlink still active in its retained prefix before resets, ellipsis text, padding, or subsequent terminal output, without changing its visible-width contract.

steps.condition: Apply only when truncation occurs; emit a close only if scanning the retained prefix leaves a hyperlink active.
steps.validation: Assert that truncating through a hyperlink label produces a matching close before the reset and ellipsis, while existing width, padding, styling, and non-truncated behavior remain unchanged.

validation_ladder: Inspect the before/after finalization diff to confirm the repair is limited to structured hyperlink closure.
Run the focused exact-output regression for a link whose closer is discarded by truncation.
Run the surrounding truncation tests covering width limits, styling resets, empty ellipses, wide graphemes, padding, and malformed escape prefixes.
Add or run an equivalent exact-output case for the alternate ST terminator before claiming both terminators have direct test coverage.
stop_conditions: Stop if the retained prefix is not available for state inspection.
Stop if terminal sequences cannot be parsed reliably enough to distinguish link opens from closes.
Defer completion if the fix changes the visible-width or truncation-selection contract without corresponding evidence and tests.
Do not claim runtime validation when the package test command cannot execute.
unresolved_or_deferred: The implementation supports both BEL and ST terminators, but the added focused regression directly covers only BEL.
Fresh test execution was unavailable because node was not installed in the extraction environment.
GitHub PR body, review discussion, and status checks were unavailable in the supplied evidence bundle.

unresolved_questions: Does another test outside the changed file directly exercise ST-terminated hyperlink truncation? No such test was established from the inspected changed files.
The committed regression oracle is present, but its runtime result could not be independently reproduced in this environment because node was unavailable.
